title: The Own Goal — EN/IT/DE (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational absurdist 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Italian German language learning trilingual football
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The own goal is a very specific kind of mistake
The kind where you did everything right
And it still ended up wrong

[Verse 2 — Italiano]
Il difensore che ha segnato il gol contro la propria squadra [The defender who scored the own goal]
Stava cercando di eliminare il pericolo [Was trying to clear the danger]
Il pallone aveva semplicemente idee diverse [The ball simply had different ideas]
Il pallone ha sempre avuto idee diverse [The ball has always had different ideas]
Il pallone non è interessato alle intenzioni [The ball is not interested in intentions]

[Chorus — English]
The own goal says — I was trying to help
The own goal says — the ball went that way
The net says nothing — the net just holds it

[Bridge — Deutsch]
Chas sagte — das Eigentor ist der ehrlichste Moment im Fußball [Chas said — the own goal is the most honest moment in football]
Weil der Spieler niemanden sonst beschuldigen kann [Because the player cannot blame anyone else]
Nicht wirklich [Not really]
Nicht lange [Not for long]
Nicht während die Zeitlupe noch läuft [Not while the replay is still running]

[Verse 3 — English]
The walk back to the halfway line after an own goal
Is one of the longest walks in sport

[Outro — EN/IT/DE]
The own goal
L'autorete [The own goal]
Das Eigentor [The own goal]
That's my boy
